run_rerank_cli: run the reranking CLI to rescore n-best MT hypotheses using multiple models and BLEU scoring
run_score_target_hypo: run score_target_hypo to compute combined scores and BLEU for hypotheses using weighted model scores
run_match_target_hypo: run match_target_hypo to find the best hyperparameters across multiple weight and length penalty combinations
run_load_score_files: run load_score_files to load generation output, bitext scores, and language model scores from shard directories
run_rerank: run rerank to generate n-best lists, score them with backward and LM models, and select the best hypothesis
